easy.def: Of that kind, or so much.
examples: It was such a fun day.
I have never seen such a big dog.
She is such a good friend.

more.def: So great, or of the kind that was just named.
examples: It was such a beautiful day that we ate lunch outside.
Animals such as bears and frogs sleep through the winter.
I had never seen such a huge pumpkin.

easy.def: Expected or told to do something.
examples: I am supposed to go.
You are supposed to wait.
She is supposed to call.

more.def: Expected or required to do something, according to a plan or a rule.
examples: We are supposed to leave at eight o'clock.
You are supposed to wash your hands before you eat.
The bus was supposed to arrive ten minutes ago.
I am sure it is mine.
Are you sure?
She is sure she can do it.

more.def: Having no doubt about something, or certain to happen.
examples: I am sure that I left my backpack by the door.
Are you sure this is the right way to the beach?
Our team is sure to win after practicing so hard.

easy.def: Something you did not know would happen.
examples: The party was a surprise!
I have a surprise for you!
What a nice surprise to see you!

more.def: Something that happens that you did not expect.
examples: It was a nice surprise to find a letter in the mailbox.
To my surprise, the cat liked the bath.
The ending of the book was a complete surprise.
Plants need water to survive.
Fish can not survive out of water.
The plant survived the cold.

more.def: To stay alive, especially through something hard or dangerous.
examples: Camels can survive for days without drinking water.
The sailors survived the storm.
Few plants can survive in such dry soil.
